plan_review.notes: Rubber-duck reviewer caught font removal regression: plan included removing Google Fonts CDN link from index.html to eliminate a render-blocking request. Reviewer confirmed Press Start 2P is used in 6 game engine files (HudQuestTracker, EquipmentUI, HudFamilyRelationships, InventoryUI, HudDirectionArrows, HudMinimap) with layout calculations dependent on its metrics. Change reverted. Remaining 3 optimizations confirmed sound: (1) Promise.all parallelization of dynamic imports in main.ts, (2) manifest fetch started in preload() to overlap with sprite loading, (3) all 6 sprite sheets loaded (removing arbitrary critical/deferred split). Performance timing marks added throughout boot pipeline.

rounds.notes: Reviewer traced all three optimizations. (1) Promise.all in main.ts: safe because floor-main-scene-options statically imports floor-registry so the ES module system dedups the load; floorId validation still happens before createFloorMainSceneOptions is called. (2) pendingRegistryFetch in BootScene: correctly initialized in preload() so manifest fetch runs in parallel with Phaser sprite sheet loading; ?? fallback handles the early-return path correctly; Promise always resolves so no unhandled rejection window. (3) All 6 sheets: roguelike-characters fix is valid (enemy.brigand/ghost were missing their texture); tiny-battle and tiny-ski produce dead Phaser texture entries but cause no errors or regressions. No significant issues found.
